title: Implement 0/1 knapsack dynamic programming in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement knapsack(capacity, weights, values) -> usize that returns the maximum total value achievable by selecting items (each at most once) within the given weight capacity.

required_artifacts: dp table of size (n+1) x (capacity+1) initialized to 0
Outer loop over items i in 1..=n
Inner loop over weights w in 0..=capacity
Take case: if weights[i-1] <= w, max with dp[i-1][w-weights[i-1]] + values[i-1]
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
